_doc: Seamless streaming between wings (workstream SEAMLESS, Nov 13 2026; design/godot-wings.md 'Seamless streaming'). scripts/wing_stream.gd reads this.
_enabled: Stage 3: turned on at the end (true for both kinds of device). ?stream=1 turns it on for a session, ?stream=0 off. May also be one value per kind of device: {"desktop": true, "mobile": false}.
_borders: Every interior border, both years: the seam between the mall wings, and the thresholds of Sears / Lynn's (4), Dillard's (5) and the cinema lobby (6; "gate": not brought in while its gate is shut, scripts/cinema_gate.gd). Lines come from gen/w<n>/wing.json (seam, thresholds).
_wing2_zones: the same list as tools/build_mall.gd WING2_ZONES: a mall wing's copy of the other wing's halls and courts (meshes named by zone) is hidden while the real wing is in.
_near_m: start loading a wing when the player is within this many metres of its border with a wing that is in. Desktop: always (the whole interior after the first load screen), one wing at a time, nearest border first.
_far_m: phones and tablets: a wing whose every border is further than this from the player is unloaded.
_handoff_past_m: the wing's own systems (shops, attendants, items, shoppers, signs) follow the player once they are this far past the border.
_people_m: a wing's own people and things (attendants, items, shop stock) are made as soon as it is in when the player is within this many metres of its border; otherwise once nothing else is loading.
_cue_m: the wordless cue (a soft pulse along the floor line) shows within this many metres of a border whose wing is still coming in.
_fallback_m: a wing whose pack could not be fetched is loaded the old way, by itself, when the player is this close to the line.
_no_crowd: wings the crowd does not walk (the cinema lobby is one empty room).
_trim: meshes that are partly the same in every wing (the skylight panes plus each wing's own shop glass): a later wing's copy loses the triangles an earlier one draws.
_hide: [{"in": wing, "when": wing, "nodes": [names]}]: meshes of wing `in` that are hidden while wing `when` is in. Wing 1 carries the cinema's dim lobby behind its doors (1990s cin_lobby; 2026 the dark recess cin_back26): the real lobby (wing 6) takes its place.
